mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies and a temperature of 27 degrees near Fireman's Park, with a full moon overhead.

City tax bills will be mailed by December 15th. The first installment is due January 31st to the City Treasurer, and payments can be made by mail, online through BS&A Payments, or at the City Center drop box.

Today, you can check out Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, trivia at The Bogey Factory, or live music at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to tomorrow, ART House 360 hosts their Thursday Night lineup and Hop Haus holds trivia.

In police updates, on Sunday, November 8th, officers responded to a single-vehicle crash on South Main Street where a car struck a curb, tree, and light pole before catching fire, leading to an O W I arrest.
Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, and today's flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate Decadence.
